remarks: Charming 1-Bedroom Apartment in South Norwalk. Welcome to your new home in the heart of Norwalk! This spacious and well-maintained 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment is located on the first floor.  Step inside to find a bright and inviting living space with large windows that bring in plenty of natural light. The kitchen features ample cabinet space and modern appliances. The bedroom is generously sized with great closet space, and full bathroom. Enjoy the perks of being just minutes away from Norwalk's vibrant downtown, shopping centers, restaurants, and public transportation. Easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway makes commuting a breeze.
